title: Authentication and sessions
rules: Core registration/login is OTP-based. Account creation occurs only after verification. Registration supports mobile OR email in this proposal; the UI discrepancy needs approval.
Mobile identifiers use E.164; email identifiers are normalized. Terms consent and the published terms version are required for registration.

OTP send/resend limits and failed-attempt limits must protect both channels and combine identifier, IP and device signals. Proposed OTP expiry: 5 minutes; resend cooldown: 30 seconds; maximum verification attempts: 5 per challenge. Delivery submission is not proof of delivery.
Challenge IDs bind identifier, purpose and pending registration. Resending invalidates the prior challenge. OTPs are single-use. Successful login responses are issued only after validation.

Access-token lifetime of 15 minutes is a proposed default, not an approved setting. Refresh-token lifetime remains a decision. Rotate refresh tokens, detect reuse, revoke the token family/session, and store mobile credentials in secure device storage.
Logout revokes the current session and refresh credentials. Protected requests must honor session revocation; clearing client storage alone is insufficient.

endpoints.title: Start verified registration
endpoints.rules: All illustrated fields required. Name must be nonblank; channel is mobile or email. No customer account is created yet.

endpoints.title: Request a login OTP
endpoints.rules: All fields required. Purpose is LOGIN; registration and contact changes use their dedicated flows. Use generic acceptance behavior to reduce account enumeration.

endpoints.title: Resend OTP
endpoints.rules: challenge_id required. Enforce cooldown and cumulative limits; previous challenge becomes unusable.

endpoints.title: Verify OTP and establish session
endpoints.rules: challenge_id and otp required; device_name optional. OTP is a string, preserving leading zeroes. Registration challenge verification creates the account and session.

endpoints.title: Rotate refresh credentials
endpoints.rules: refresh_token required. Rotation is atomic; expired, revoked or reused credentials cannot establish a session.

endpoints.title: Revoke current session
endpoints.rules: Idempotent for a recognized session; do not accept a customer ID in the body.

title: Conditional password option
rules: These four operations are CONDITIONAL: include only if the client retains the password option shown on the login screen. OTP remains the core path.
A verified password-setup/change proof is obtained through a purpose-bound OTP challenge extension. Do not reuse a normal access token as proof of recent verification.
Use secure password hashing and an approved password policy. Reset requests must use generic responses; recovery delivery, proof issuance and expiry require a final design.

endpoints.title: Password login
endpoints.rules: identifier and password required; device_name optional. Conditional operation.

endpoints.title: Set or change password
endpoints.rules: Both fields required. Recent verification proof is single-use and bound to password setup/change.

endpoints.title: Request password recovery
endpoints.rules: identifier required. Generic response regardless of account existence.

endpoints.title: Complete password recovery
endpoints.rules: Both fields required. Proof must be purpose-bound, single-use and unexpired.

title: Customer profile
rules: Only the authenticated customer's profile is accessible. Profile updates cannot set ownership, permissions, verified flags or account roles.
Name must be nonblank. Address is optional; when provided validate city, postal code and country. Profile PATCH preserves omitted fields.
Changing mobile/email requires verification of the new identifier and approved recent-authentication checks. Keep the old contact until verification completes; prevent duplicate verified contacts.
Profile photos use a customer-owned READY attachment with PROFILE_PHOTO purpose. Deleting the profile photo detaches it subject to storage cleanup policy.

endpoints.title: Update name/address
endpoints.rules: At least one supported field required; both name and address are individually optional. Contacts must use the verified contact-change flow.

endpoints.title: Start contact change
endpoints.rules: Both fields required. channel is mobile or email. New identifier must not conflict with another account.

endpoints.title: Verify and apply new contact
endpoints.rules: Both fields required. Apply the new contact atomically; recheck uniqueness.

endpoints.title: Set profile photo
endpoints.rules: attachment_id required and must be READY, PROFILE_PHOTO and customer-owned.

title: Vehicles and service history
rules: Vehicle IDs must belong to the customer. Registration numbers are normalized and validated; duplicate active entries for the same customer are rejected.

Required on create: registration_number, brand, model, fuel_type. Proposed optional fields: year, odometer_km, is_default. Fuel type must come from the approved enum; odometer is nonnegative and year is plausible.
Exactly one default when vehicles exist is the proposed rule. Default changes are atomic; deletion of a default requires a replacement rule.
Removal is blocked while active work exists. Use archival where necessary so historical jobs and invoices remain accessible.

endpoints.title: Edit vehicle
endpoints.rules: At least one editable field required. All create fields except is_default may be patched; use the dedicated default endpoint.

title: Secure attachments
rules: Supported purposes: PROFILE_PHOTO, BOOKING_PHOTO, SUPPORT_ATTACHMENT. Job photos are uploaded by garages, not customers.
Photo defaults proposed for approval: JPEG/PNG/WebP, up to 5 MB each, maximum 5 booking photos. Support formats/limits require approval.
Validate actual bytes, MIME type and size; sanitize filenames; scan as appropriate. Only READY, owned, purpose-compatible attachments can be linked.
Downloads authorize access using ownership or the permitted linked job/context. Never expose permanent public URLs for private files. Deletion must respect links and retention policies.

endpoints.title: Upload attachment
endpoints.rules: file and purpose required. Return READY only after required validation/scanning completes.

endpoints.title: Download authorized attachment
endpoints.response: Binary response: Content-Type: image/jpeg; Content-Disposition: inline; filename="vehicle-front.jpg"

title: Availability and booking summary
rules: Reject past appointment dates, inactive services and slots too short for selected service duration. Use each garage's IANA timezone; future means future at that garage.
Availability is advisory. Quote creation does not reserve capacity in this proposal. Submission must atomically recheck capacity, service availability, vehicle ownership and quote validity.
Selection can remain in the app until quote submission; no persistent selection API is required by the workbook.
Estimated totals are computed server-side and are not final invoices. The quote binds customer, garage, vehicle, selected services, slot, notes and owned attachment IDs.

endpoints.title: Find appointment slots
endpoints.rules: date and at least one service ID required.

endpoints.title: Validate selection and review summary
endpoints.rules: garage_id, vehicle_id, nonempty unique service_ids and slot_id required. notes and attachment_ids optional. Proposed notes limit: 2,000 characters.

title: Booking management
rules: Booking states: PENDING, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, CANCELLED, CONVERTED, EXPIRED. COMPLETED is a linked-job filter, not a booking state.
Garages alone accept/reject bookings and convert them into jobs. Customers cannot supply garage decision timestamps or change status directly.

Proposed baseline: customer cancellation is allowed only while PENDING, before work begins. Accepted-booking cancellation, cutoff periods and fees need client approval. Expose can_cancel and a reason when unavailable.

Idempotency keys are scoped to customer and operation. Same key and same payload return the original result; same key with a different payload returns 409. Capacity and booking creation occur atomically.

endpoints.title: Submit booking request
endpoints.rules: quote_id required. customer_id is derived from the session and is not accepted from the client.

endpoints.title: List own bookings
endpoints.rules: Optional status, vehicle_id, garage_id and linked_job_status filters. Completed tab: linked_job_status=COMPLETED.

response.cancellation_unavailable_reason: Only pending bookings can be cancelled

endpoints.title: Cancel eligible booking
endpoints.rules: reason required, nonblank, proposed maximum 500 characters. Sample cancellation uses a separate PENDING booking_002; booking_001 was accepted.

title: Published job tracking - read only
rules: Job states: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_FOR_PARTS, QUALITY_CHECK, READY, COMPLETED, CANCELLED.
Customer access is read-only. No customer job-create, job-update, status-change, labour/parts mutation or garage-photo upload operation is permitted.
Only published/customer-visible findings, notes, photos, services, parts and labour are returned. Exclude internal notes, cost margins, staff-only fields and unrelated customer information.
Timeline events are chronological. A converted booking exposes its linked garage-created job and job creation timestamp.

endpoints.title: List accessible jobs
endpoints.rules: Optional status and vehicle_id filters.

title: Invoices and secure PDF downloads
rules: Expose only the customer's published final invoice after the job meets completion/publication rules. Missing historical bills are not fabricated by this specification.
Payment display states: UNPAID, PENDING, PAID, FAILED, REFUNDED. These must be derived from server-confirmed financial records and reconciled attempts.
Amounts are integer paise in INR. Example: subtotal 150000 + tax 27000 - discount 0 = total 177000. Tax/discount ordering and legal invoice fields must follow the approved billing policy.
Invoice PDF is an authenticated binary response. The mobile app uses its native share action after download; no separate public share endpoint is required.

endpoints.title: List final invoices
endpoints.rules: Optional payment_status, job_id and vehicle_id filters.

endpoints.title: Download/share invoice PDF
endpoints.response: Binary response: Content-Type: application/pdf; Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="GFC-I-000001.pdf"

title: Payments and safe retries
rules: Payment provider is undecided. Checkout fields are illustrative placeholders until the selected provider's official contract is adopted.
The backend calculates the invoice balance, currency and gateway order. Never accept client-supplied settled status or amount.
Retry uses the same creation endpoint with a new idempotency key after a confirmed failed attempt. Reuse an active valid attempt; reject creation for a fully settled invoice.
Only a verified provider webhook or server-side gateway verification may confirm settlement. Verify order mapping, amount and currency; deduplicate events; make invoice/payment changes transactional.
return_path is optional and restricted to approved in-app routes; never accept an arbitrary external redirect. Partial payments/refunds are outside the approved scope until separately decided.

endpoints.title: Start or retry payment
endpoints.rules: Body may be {}. Return 200 if reusing an existing active attempt rather than creating one.

endpoints.title: Check confirmed payment result
endpoints.rules: Example shows the successful retry payment_002; payment_001 appears as failed in attempt history.

endpoints.title: Download settled payment receipt
endpoints.response: Binary PDF response: Content-Type: application/pdf; Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="payment-receipt.pdf"
endpoints.rules: Available only for a server-confirmed paid attempt.

title: Notifications and unified activity center
rules: Categories: BOOKINGS, JOBS, INVOICES, MESSAGES, PAYMENTS, REVIEWS, SUPPORT. Each event includes timestamp, read state and authorized linked-record context.
Create in-app activity independently of push delivery. Booking accepted/rejected, job created/status changed, invoice published, payment outcome, message/review/support events feed this center.
Device tokens belong to an app installation bound to the current customer/session. Logout detaches it as appropriate; do not keep sending a previous customer's private events on a shared phone.

endpoints.title: Register/update push installation
endpoints.rules: platform and push_token required; platform enum ANDROID or IOS.

endpoints.title: List/filter activity
endpoints.rules: Omit category for All. unread_count is the count matching the selected category, independent of pagination.

endpoints.title: Mark notification read
endpoints.rules: is_read required and must be true for this contract.

endpoints.title: Mark all/filtered activity read
endpoints.rules: category optional; {} marks all categories. Operate on current customer's records only.

title: Garage conversations
rules: This is UI-required scope even though the workbook has no separate numbered messaging story.

Start conversations using exactly one customer-owned booking_id or job_id. Derive the garage from that record. Reuse an existing conversation for the context; define continuity when a booking converts to a job.
Only context participants can read/send. Proposed messages are plain text with maximum 2,000 characters. Post-completion/cancellation sending permissions need approval.
client_message_id is required for sends and deduplicated per sender/conversation. Cursor pagination is chronological and stable. Matching garage-side participant APIs are required.

endpoints.title: Open or reuse contextual conversation
endpoints.rules: Exactly one booking_id or job_id required. Return 200 when reusing an existing conversation.

endpoints.title: Read message history
endpoints.rules: cursor optional; limit proposed range 1..100.

endpoints.title: Send customer message

request.text: Thank you. I will arrive on time.

response.text: Thank you. I will arrive on time.

endpoints.rules: Both fields required. sender_role and timestamp are server-controlled.

endpoints.title: Advance read marker
endpoints.rules: last_read_message_id required and must belong to this conversation; markers cannot move backwards.

title: Ratings and reviews
rules: Only the customer owning a COMPLETED job may review it. Enforce one review per completed job; derive garage_id and customer_id server-side.
rating is required integer 1..5; comment optional, proposed maximum 2,000 characters. Author may edit subject to an approved edit window.
Examples propose PENDING moderation before publication and after editing. Public endpoints exclude unapproved content. Define rating aggregation and moderation policy before implementation.

endpoints.title: Edit own review

request.comment: Good service; delivery took longer than expected.

response.comment: Good service; delivery took longer than expected.

endpoints.rules: At least one of rating or comment required. Only author can edit.

title: Customer support tickets and replies
rules: Ticket requires category, subject and description. Proposed text limits: subject 200 characters; description 5,000; reply 2,000. Categories and attachment limits require approval.
Optional linked booking/job/invoice/payment IDs must be owned by the customer and mutually consistent; general issues need no linked IDs.
Customers view status and external replies only; they cannot set internal ticket status or access internal support notes. Reopening/closing policy requires approval.

request.subject: Payment status not updated
request.description: Payment completed but the invoice still shows pending.

response.subject: Payment status not updated
response.description: Payment completed but the invoice still shows pending.

endpoints.title: Read customer-visible support replies
endpoints.rules: cursor optional; limit proposed range 1..100.

endpoints.title: Reply to support
endpoints.rules: client_message_id and nonblank text required; attachment_ids optional and customer-owned.
